title: Email/set created articles use hardcoded '01 Jan 2024' date
description: mail/email/set.rs:187: all POST-created articles have Date: Mon, 01 Jan 2024 00:00:00 +0000. Line 176-179 correctly computes a timestamp-based message-id but the Date header ignores it. All created articles appear simultaneous; chronological ordering is impossible. Fix: format the timestamp from line 176 as an RFC 5322 date string and use it at line 187.
